WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price,
    average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM invoice_averages
),
centered_deviations AS (
  SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price,
    deviation,
    deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_centered_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  average_unit_price,
  deviation,
  country_centered_deviation
FROM centered_deviations
ORDER BY country_centered_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with no invoice lines are excluded because their average line UnitPrice is undefined; NULL countries are grouped together as one country.
